info.name: Task Scheduler Collection
info.description: Coleção de testes para o Task Scheduler, incluindo diferentes tipos de agendamento: REST, SOAP, BATCH e MENSAGERIA

item.name: REST API
REST API Pública - Open Weather Map

body.raw:
{
  "name": "REST API Pública - Open Weather Map",
  "description": "Chamada à API pública do Open Weather Map para obter dados meteorológicos de uma cidade",
  "taskType": "REST_CALL",
  "status": "INACTIVE",
  "cronExpression": "0 0/30 * * * ?",
  "maxRetries": 3,
  "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
  "restTaskConfig": {
    "url": "https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=Sao%20Paulo&appid=439d4b804bc8187953eb36d2a8c26a02&units=metric",
    "method": "GET",
    "headers": "Accept: application/json\nContent-Type: application/json",
    "body": "",
    "authType": "NONE",
    "connectTimeoutSeconds": 30,
    "readTimeoutSeconds": 30
  }
}

item.name: SOAP API
SOAP API Pública - Serviço de Conversão de Temperatura

body.raw:
{
  "name": "SOAP API Pública - Serviço de Conversão de Temperatura",
  "description": "Chamada a um serviço SOAP público para conversão de temperatura",
  "taskType": "SOAP_CALL",
  "status": "INACTIVE",
  "cronExpression": "0 0 8 * * ?",
  "maxRetries": 3,
  "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
  "soapTaskConfig": {
    "endpointUrl": "https://www.w3schools.com/xml/tempconvert.asmx",
    "soapAction": "https://www.w3schools.com/xml/CelsiusToFahrenheit",
    "requestXml": "<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\" xmlns:web=\"https://www.w3schools.com/xml/\">\n   <soapenv:Header/>\n   <soapenv:Body>\n      <web:CelsiusToFahrenheit>\n         <web:Celsius>25</web:Celsius>\n      </web:CelsiusToFahrenheit>\n   </soapenv:Body>\n</soapenv:Envelope>",
    "authType": "NONE",
    "connectTimeoutSeconds": 30,
    "readTimeoutSeconds": 30
  }
}

request.description: Cria uma tarefa para chamar um serviço SOAP público de conversão de temperatura

item.name: BATCH
Batch Low Platform - Processamento de Dados

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Batch Low Platform - Processamento de Dados",
  "description": "Chamada ao nosso serviço batch de baixa plataforma",
  "taskType": "LOW_PLATFORM_BATCH",
  "status": "INACTIVE",
  "cronExpression": "0 0 2 * * ?",
  "maxRetries": 2,
  "retryDelaySeconds": 120,
  "lowPlatformBatchConfig": {
    "command": "java -jar /app/batch-low-platform.jar",
    "workingDirectory": "/opt/batch",
    "environmentVariables": "SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=batch\nBATCH_JOB_NAME=processJob",
    "successExitCodes": "0",
    "onSuccessCommand": "echo 'Batch processado com sucesso' >> /var/log/batch.log",
    "onFailureCommand": "echo 'Falha no processamento do batch' >> /var/log/batch.log",
    "timeoutSeconds": 300
  }
}

request.description: Cria uma tarefa para executar um batch de baixa plataforma

item.name: MENSAGERIA

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Kafka - Envio de Mensagem",
  "description": "Envio de mensagem para um tópico Kafka",
  "taskType": "MESSAGING",
  "status": "INACTIVE",
  "cronExpression": "0 */10 * * * ?",
  "maxRetries": 3,
  "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
  "messagingTaskConfig": {
    "brokerType": "KAFKA",
    "destination": "task-events",
    "message": "{\n  \"taskId\": 1234,\n  \"eventType\": \"SCHEDULED\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"{{timestamp}}\",\n  \"details\": \"Tarefa agendada pelo sistema\"\n}",
    "connectionProperties": "bootstrap.servers={{kafka_broker}}\nkey.serializer=org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer\nvalue.serializer=org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer",
    "authType": "NONE",
    "deliveryMode": "PERSISTENT",
    "timeoutSeconds": 30
  }
}

request.description: Cria uma tarefa para enviar mensagem para um tópico Kafka
